name: tuned-tensor
description: Codex plugin for Tuned Tensor training with local or user-owned AWS GPUs, evaluation, and local serving.

interface.shortDescription: Build and operate Tuned Tensor behaviour specs.
interface.longDescription: Helps Codex use one tt pipeline for token-free training with local or user-owned AWS GPUs, local evaluation and serving, account reporting, and a local agent with managed Tuned Tensor inference or a user-selected provider and model.
defaultPrompt: Fine-tune a Tuned Tensor model from this behaviour spec.
Serve this Tuned Tensor model locally on port 8000.
Inspect my Tuned Tensor run report and summarize regressions.
